content.short: Algebra Protocol provides modular concentrated liquidity infrastructure for teams building decentralized exchanges.
content.description: Algebra Protocol is DEX infrastructure for teams that want to launch concentrated liquidity exchanges with more flexibility than a fixed AMM design. Its docs describe a modular architecture with a secure core, upgradeable plugins, dynamic or static fee mechanics, built in farming support, and tools for deploying pools, routers, and frontends across EVM chains. Rather than acting as a single retail exchange, Algebra serves as the engine behind other DEX products. On Mantle, its relevance comes from powering exchange infrastructure that local protocols can adapt for their own liquidity, fee, and incentive models.

resources.title: How Algebra Made QuickSwap Liquidity 4x More Fee-Efficient
resources.tldr: A case study with actual numbers: QuickSwap's Algebra-based V3 earned 4.1x the fees and 17x the volume per dollar of TVL compared with its own V2 on Polygon.

resources.title: How Algebra's NAV Plugin Enables Efficient RWA Trading on Base
resources.tldr: Tokenized real-world assets price off net asset value rather than order flow, which breaks the usual AMM curve. Covers how an oracle-aware plugin reshapes the pool around that.
